title: UTMB World Series Majors — Kodiak as 2027 Americas Major
claims: UTMB's Majors page lists HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB as one of the two 2027 Americas Majors, alongside HOKA Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB.
The page's Finals prize table lists only UTMB, CCC and OCC.
